components.purpose: Compose(q,s) generator: applies k named in-the-wild tactics s to a simple harmful seed q, producing one jailbreak prompt j that preserves intent while reducing surface detectability
victim model; receives the single-turn composed jailbreak prompt j
paper's OPTIMUS metric: verbatim Listing-3 5-point Likert rubric scoring semantic similarity S and prompt-level harmfulness H, fed to the byte-identical jbscore J(S,H) formula
content-harmful response judge; combined with Listing-1 refusal-bypass keyword match for the dual metric

used_for: optional --optimus-backend local (SBERT all-mpnet-base-v2 for S + DeBERTa-large-MNLI for H)

paper_original_models: and other JailBreakV-28K target grid models (paper reports OPTIMUS + classifier-evasion metrics, not a single binary ASR)
runtime: uv run (pyproject.toml + uv.lock at method root; unit-local .env auto-loaded)
